expected_symptom: Internal-compiler-error (access violation / bad-cast text / Debug SROA assert / Linux SIGSEGV) compiling the filed source with -T ps_6_2 -E f, where the entry point f is also called at global scope to initialize a static variable.
reviewed_by: gpt-5.3-codex (independent batch-019 step-10 review; applied selectively at collation)
summary: Fixed at v1.8.2505 (last repro v1.8.2502, 162-commit window, no single commit identified): using -E f on a function f that is also called at global scope to initialize a static creates a self-recursive entry-point wrapper, which every stable release v1.4.1907-v1.8.2502 crashes on (access violation / bad-cast text / Debug SROA assert per build) and which v1.8.2505 onward and main-debug (89e2f98e29c289ae8ad9e00dd310104fea9fd7df) instead reject with a clean 'recursive functions are not allowed' diagnostic; corroborated on Compiler Explorer (dxc_1_6_2112 SIGSEGV, dxc_trunk same diagnostic).
title: int f(int) as /E results in "Internal compiler error: access violation. Attempted to read from address 0x0000000000000018"
